TOOLING BURST T4h — SPEC § 7 row "T4h — piece-burst template (E0-p step 3)" (Run C-5: the decomposed fire peak comes alive at runtime, no video). task_id "T4h".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 (the intro paragraph; the row "T4h — piece-burst template" — your contract, its Acceptance column is how your work is measured; the rows T4a (material), T4b (G1 component + effect-age clock), T4c (replay + bake), T4e as corrected (the pieces you consume)).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (the G1 component emission, the effect-age clock, grey substitution), export/vfx_material.gdshader (erosion + band-step dissolve uniforms), export/replay.py (bake), oracle/vfx_measure.py (VO1 coverage over time), runs/C-5/t3/T4e-r1/pieces/pieces.json + the piece PNGs + peak_index.png (T4e-r1's delivered output: 24 pieces = 11 main-body spatial shards + 13 detached source islands < 40 px — consume its schema AS DELIVERED; do not re-decompose; pieces with area < 48 px are NOT animated: they show during the intact-peak hold and are dropped when the pieces fly), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json + runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/frozen_orb/kit.json (kit schema precedent), tests/test_effect_kit.py and tests/test_godot_import.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot at /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot for headless import + bake runs (each < 2 min).

BUILD exactly the SPEC row: (1) `export/effect_kit.py`: a `pieces` phase — kit field `pieces: {source: <pieces.json path>, template: "burst_v1", hold_frames: 1|2, base_speed_px_s, residue_s, residue_fraction: 0.15–0.25, seed}`, validated (every piece mask exists, pivots inside masks, band ∈ 0..3); (2) `export/godot_import.py` emits `scenes/vfx/piece_burst.tscn` + `scripts/vfx/piece_burst.gd`: on impact — runtime onset flash (T4a flash layer) → the intact peak (peak_index.png on the T4a material) held `hold_frames` → the peak sprite hides and every piece appears as its own Sprite2D (mask PNG on the shared T4a material, band index → palette, LINEAR filter) at its recorded pivot, then flies outward from the burst centre along its recorded radial angle with speed = base_speed × a seeded per-piece factor in [0.6, 1.4], rotation ≤ ±30° over its life, scale stepped in integer native steps within ±15 %; centre-out erosion driven by each piece's own distance field (`distance_fields` — generate per piece if T4e did not) and the shader's band-step dissolve (band 3 first); the effect ends as RESIDUE BY EROSION — total coverage held at residue_fraction of peak coverage for residue_s, never by scaling — then release; everything on the 60 Hz effect-age clock (T4b), deterministic under `seed`, grey substitution honoured (mid-grey bodies, same alpha); (3) a kit `runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p/kit.json` using T4e-r1's pieces (copy the piece PNGs + peak_index.png into the kit directory; the kit is self-contained) (fire palette: band 0 = dark ember (0.25,0.08,0.04), 1 = deep red (0.7,0.16,0.08), 2 = orange (1.0,0.55,0.12), 3 = pale yellow (1.0,0.94,0.75); halo + floor light on; dark duplicate ON as a preset field) registered in kits_v9.json so the picker (Tab) reaches it as the SEVENTH kit — cast it as a G1 fire bolt using the existing travel body of blackwater_cocktail's flask? NO: use a plain 12-px band-2 dot as the travel body (a temporary placeholder the conductor replaces at E1) so the burst is reachable in the scene; (4) bake it with T4c (`export/replay.py`, bake=True, 126 frames, effect `res://scenes/vfx/piece_burst.tscn` or the emitted impact scene name) into runs/C-5/t3/T4h/bake/ and measure VO1 coverage over time with oracle/vfx_measure.py; write runs/C-5/t3/T4h/acceptance.json with: hold frames observed, extent at 0.25 s vs peak extent (≥ 2×), residue fraction + duration, shard count per frame vs piece count, two-seed-equal bake sha comparison (byte-identical), any piece scale outside ±15 %.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation rejects a missing mask / a pivot outside its mask / residue_fraction out of range; the emitted .tscn/.gd contain the piece nodes, the clock hook and the residue-by-erosion path (string-level checks + the headless import proof exit 0 on a fixture project); the seeded per-piece factor is deterministic.
ACCEPTANCE (SPEC row): hold → expansion (extent ≥ 2× peak extent within 0.25 s) → erosion to a 15–25 % residue held ≥ 0.3 s → zero; shard count in the bake equals the piece count until the residue phase; two seeded bakes byte-identical; RED: any piece scaled outside ±15 %, residue reached by scaling, bakes differing between seed-equal runs. Report-not-stop (V17): if the bake cannot be measured, deliver the diagnosis. Then run the FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected: all green except the five standing reds (test_f04_outside_at_least_three; three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid); report tests_run, successful, and name every red.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (T4e owns peak_pieces.py; vfx_measure.py is frozen), any existing test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4h/ and the new kit directory runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p/ (+ the one-line registration in kits_v9.json). Existing functions keep their signatures and defaults; the six kits_v9 kits must export byte-identically. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4h/. Write out/files.json listing every file you added or changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4h"): files = every added/changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
